objective: V4.3.2 Spark Corpus Expansion + Legacy Demotion — aggressively grow the V4 spark corpus and make sparks the primary cognitive log, while preserving memory_items only as receipts/audit until safe archival completes.
context: V4.3.1 proved the migration path and seeded the first batch: sparks grew from 3 to 27, with 2 active and 25 candidate, while memory_items stayed intact. The user goal is one living memory log: sparks. Before V4.4 chat wire, Crowley needs much broader spark coverage, a reviewed promotion policy, and a path to demote/archive migrated or low-value memory_items from cognitive use without deleting audit history.
decisions: Cursor implements all V4.3.2 tickets before V4.4 #363 is claimed.
Sparks are the living cognitive log; memory_items are receipts/audit/fallback only.
Expansion may run larger than V4.3.1 but remains batch-based, dry-run-first, and capped.
No DELETE of memory_items in V4.3.2; archive/stale only after lineage or explicit noise classification.
Every migrated spark must preserve source_memory_item_id and migration lineage.
Promotion to active/pinned requires deterministic policy or review report; broad auto-promotion is not allowed.
Legacy fallback remains available until lock tests prove common Crowley queries resolve from sparks.
No crowley.py rewrite and no CROWLEY_VERSION bump.
non_goals: Bulk dumping all memory_items as active sparks
risks: Aggressive migration turns ticket chatter into cognitive noise
Legacy archive hides useful receipts before spark coverage is real
Promotion mistakes make stale decisions authoritative
Batch apply creates duplicate or overlong sparks
Common Crowley queries still fall back to memory_items after migration
Archive tooling mutates rows without a reversible report
qa_expectations: Per ticket: focused migration tests, archive/demotion safety tests, cognitive context smoke, V4.3 retrieval acceptance, Actions registry contracts. Full unittest discovery at T5. Production apply/archive operations must be report-backed and bounded.
next_action: Mint and run V4.3.2 before V4.4 #363. Cursor claims T1 first. Do not start dashboard or V4.4 chat wire until V4.3.2 T5 is approved.

approval.note: User wants sparks to become the single living memory log; V4.3.2 expands coverage and demotes legacy safely before V4.4.

tickets.title: V4.3.2 T1: corpus coverage targets and aggressive candidate tiers
tickets.description: Extend the V4.3.1 inventory/selector with explicit coverage targets and tiered candidate classes for aggressive migration. Define Tier A canon/pinned/current-state, Tier B durable decisions/constraints/preferences/lessons, Tier C high-signal project updates, and Tier D receipts/noise excluded from sparks. Produce a coverage report showing active/pinned spark coverage by memory_type, lane, source, and current active_memory_items_without_spark_lineage. Files: memory_spark_migration.py, scripts/select_memory_spark_candidates.py, docs/V4.3.2_SPARK_CORPUS_EXPANSION_PLAN.md, tests/test_spark_corpus_coverage.py. Depends on V4.3.1 lock.
acceptance: Coverage report includes targets for active/pinned sparks and total migrated lineage
Candidate tiers are explicit and deterministic
Tier A/B rank before ticket approval chatter
Receipts, QA noise, and side-quest recovery chatter remain excluded unless manually whitelisted
Report identifies how many rows remain in each tier
Tests cover tier ordering and exclusion rules

tickets.title: V4.3.2 T2: reviewed multi-batch spark expansion
tickets.description: Run and harden repeated bounded migration batches from the existing extraction path. Add support for --tier, --max-batches, and a required dry-run artifact before apply. Apply may process larger total volume than V4.3.1, but each batch remains capped (default max 50) and idempotent. Generate per-batch and cumulative reports with inserted/linked/merged/rejected/skipped counts. Files: memory_spark_migration.py, scripts/extract_memory_items_to_sparks.py, docs/artifacts reports, tests/test_spark_corpus_batch_expansion.py. Depends on T1.
acceptance: Apply refuses to run without a recent dry-run artifact or explicit review flag
Each batch has a bounded limit and unique batch id
Repeated runs are idempotent and skip already-linked rows
Cumulative report records before/after spark and memory_items counts
All inserted sparks preserve source_memory_item_id and lineage
No memory_items are archived/deleted in T2
Tests cover multi-batch idempotency and cap enforcement

tickets.title: V4.3.2 T3: promotion review for active/pinned spark coverage
tickets.description: Add a promotion review tool that evaluates candidate migration sparks for active/pinned promotion without broad auto-promotion. Promote only confirmed canon/current-state/durable decisions/constraints/preferences with sufficient confidence and clean validation. Produce review and apply reports. Files: memory_spark_migration.py or new scripts/review_migrated_sparks.py, spark_lifecycle.py only if needed, tests/test_spark_corpus_promotion_review.py. Depends on T2.
acceptance: Promotion review dry-run lists candidates, reasons, and holds
Promotion apply requires explicit --apply and bounded --limit
Only deterministic policy can promote active/pinned
Ticket approval/denial chatter remains candidate unless manually whitelisted
Promoted sparks keep source_memory_item_id and lineage
Tests cover promote, hold, and no broad auto-promotion

tickets.title: V4.3.2 T4: legacy memory_items demotion and archive safeguards
tickets.description: Add dry-run and apply tooling to demote legacy memory_items out of cognitive use after spark coverage exists. Do not delete rows. Archive/stale only rows with spark lineage or deterministic low-value/noise classification, preserving ticket-linked and pinned/canon receipts unless explicitly represented by active/pinned sparks. Update retrieval/cold-start docs only; do not remove retrieve_memories API. Files: scripts/archive_migrated_memory_items.py or memory_spark_migration.py, tests/test_legacy_memory_demotion.py. Depends on T3.
acceptance: Archive/demotion dry-run is required before apply
No memory_items are deleted
Pinned/canon/ticket-linked receipts are protected unless represented by active/pinned sparks
Rows with spark lineage may be marked archived/stale only with report evidence
Low-value receipts/noise classification is deterministic and auditable
Apply report lists every changed memory_item id and reason
Tests prove protected rows are not archived prematurely

tickets.title: V4.3.2 T5: spark-first lock and legacy fallback threshold
tickets.description: Add docs/V4.3.2_SPARK_CORPUS_EXPANSION_LOCK.md recording before/after coverage, migration batches, promotion review, demotion/archive evidence, and remaining legacy fallback scope. Add cognitive context smoke tests for common Crowley queries proving sparks are primary and fallback is exceptional. Update docs/TICKETS.md to mark V4.3.2 locked and V4.4 unblocked. Run focused suites and full unittest discovery. Depends on T1–T4.
acceptance: Lock doc records spark coverage before/after by trust_state/lane/source_memory_item_id
Lock doc records memory_items active/archive/stale counts before/after
Common Crowley queries return active/pinned sparks without relying on memory_items fallback when coverage exists
Legacy fallback remains available but is documented as exceptional
V4.3 retrieval acceptance tests still pass
Actions/crowley_tools registry contract tests still pass
Full unittest discovery passes
docs/TICKETS.md shows V4.3.2 locked and V4.4 next
